hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts annual depreciation and amortization burden relief (D&A/revenue falling year over year, with revenue not contracting and D&A growing slower than revenue) paired with liquid SPY-relative leadership may identify asset-light operating leverage candidates with 10-day continuation beyond generic momentum.

prediction.confidence_reason: Raw SEC D&A expense burden is distinct from recent low-capex, operating-efficiency, SG&A, lease, and debt fields. The economic edge is asset-light operating leverage when D&A/revenue falls while revenue is stable and price confirms demand. The disconfirmer is that recent Companyfacts quality candidate pools are saturated and often fail window, drawdown, or accepted-comparator gates.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual D&A/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual D&A/revenue burden-relief gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The raw SEC D&A burden-relief source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high). It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +1.0431; aggregate PnL delta $+19,408.82; max drawdown drift +0.0316; 241 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping D&A/revenue burden, D&A growth spread, revenue floor, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT asset-light evidence, such as capex-to-D&A replacement-cycle context, fixed-asset turnover by industry, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep D&A tags, D&A/revenue thresholds, revenue floor, freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
